final: WITH track_counts AS (SELECT TrackId, COUNT(*) as track_count FROM PlaylistTrack GROUP BY TrackId), total_sum AS (SELECT SUM(track_count) as total_count FROM track_counts WHERE track_count IS NOT NULL), shares AS (SELECT track_counts.TrackId, track_counts.track_count, CAST(track_counts.track_count AS FLOAT) / total_sum.total_count as share FROM track_counts, total_sum WHERE total_sum.total_count IS NOT NULL), avg_share_val AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share_value FROM shares WHERE share IS NOT NULL), filtered AS (SELECT shares.track_count, shares.share FROM shares, avg_share_val WHERE shares.share > avg_share_val.avg_share_value) SELECT AVG(track_count) as avg_track_count, AVG(share) as avg_share, AVG(share - (SELECT avg_share_value FROM avg_share_val)) as avg_share_deviation FROM filtered
